description: Opens one message and returns its full text, sender, recipients, date and attachment names. Doesn't mark it as read unless asked.

account.description: Which mailbox to use, by its name or email address. Configured: none configured yet. Required when more than one is set up.

folder.description: Folder to look in. Defaults to the inbox. Accepts "inbox", "sent", "drafts", "trash", "spam", "archive" or an exact folder name from list_folders.

id.description: The message id shown in search or inbox results (unique within its folder).

mark_as_read.description: Also mark the message as read. Defaults to false so the user still sees it as new.

name: read_email
title: Read email
